title: 水の出口
time: 召喚当日・昼から夕方
state: 三階へ召喚。帰還門は調査中。エルナの区画で修理許可を得る。枯れた株は回復しない。

scenes.scrollPurpose: 日常の手仕事を見せ、塔の畑への伏線にする。

soundEffects.source: hand trowel enters soil
soundEffects.placement: small rough dark-brown letters beside the blade

scenes.description: At a real ordinary Earth vegetable plot shortly before summoning, TWO unequal shots: upper near-full-width closeup of Kou's trowel opening wet soil, lower larger medium view of Kou kneeling beside normal leafy vegetable rows. Same tan work jacket, cream shirt, green waist apron and brown boots. Real outdoor sky allowed ONLY in this memory. No other people, no magic yet.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 光と白い間をたどり、着地の場所を次まで見せない。

soundEffects.source: sudden summoning flash
soundEffects.placement: bold white-center gold-outlined letters at the upper flash, upright, no balloon

scenes.description: ONE borderless tall vertical transition. Earth soil and Kou's working hand at the top are interrupted by a brilliant white flash. The light descends through the middle into a pale ivory empty-looking fall, then one closeup of his startled eye at the bottom. He does not die or get injured. No tower, gate, future cause, symbols or magical source revealed. A disorienting moment rather than a poster.

One tall borderless vertical scene: Kou startled and unsteady on the paved lane at the top; his eyes follow immense pale sandstone ribs to the glowing ceiling; downward motion returns to his dirt-stained hands and green apron. Tower interior only, NOT open outdoor sky. He remembers farming but no Earth scene. Two separate moments, not duplicate simultaneous people.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 靴、剣、通行人を見て異世界だと理解する。

soundEffects.source: guard armor moves while walking
soundEffects.placement: small hard metallic dark-gray lettering near armor

soundEffects.source: guard boots on stone
soundEffects.placement: small separated footsteps following the downward path

scenes.description: THREE unequal successive observations inside the tower lane, no combat: upper shallow closeup of an anonymous armored guard's boots and sheathed sword passing; middle small RIGHT closeup of Kou's startled eye; lower larger wide view from behind Kou watching ordinary adventurers move under sandstone ceiling ribs. The guard wears a plain steel helmet, NOT Leon, no silver-haired face. Keep all weapons sheathed. Kou alone from main reference.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 尋ねる勇気を出して、受付の会話へつなぐ。
scenes.description: TWO staggered conversation beats in the same tower street: upper close face of hesitant Kou looking toward a wooden administrative stall; lower larger medium Kou respectfully speaking to an ordinary older gray-haired beige-robed clerk sitting behind the desk. The clerk is the same ordinary official used in the following gate exchange, not a main-reference supporting hero. No gate answer or map yet.

dialogue: 帰還の門は、今は閉じてる。
帰る方法は、あるんですね？
調査待ちだ。まずは寝床だ。
scenes.description: Three unequal panels: medium Kou facing a plain wooden administrative desk; closer offscreen clerk's hand indicating a closed stone gate diagram without lettering; closeup Kou absorbing the answer. Clerk is an ordinary older adult in beige robe, not Leon. Show patient exchange, hope and worry.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 帰れない事実を受け止める無音の間。

soundEffects.source: Kou tightens his fist
soundEffects.placement: small beside the clenched hand

scenes.description: TWO very unequal silent shots after the clerk's answer: upper tall borderless view of a shut pale stone return portal recessed under sandstone ribs, inert and dark, with Kou small at its foot; lower narrow closeup of Kou's empty open hand relaxing into a tense fist. No magical portal opening, no code, no modern phone, no proof of why it is shut.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 空の財布と腹の音で、働いて食べる必要を伝える。

soundEffects.source: leather purse squeezed
soundEffects.placement: tiny crisp letters by leather fold

soundEffects.source: Kou boot meets paving
soundEffects.placement: short dark lettering near heel

soundEffects.source: Kou stomach rumble
soundEffects.placement: soft wavy letters beside stomach, no balloon

scenes.description: THREE quick, staggered small closeups down a pale ivory ground: Kou checks a worn leather coin pouch that is empty, takes a step on the stone lane, then presses his empty stomach under cream shirt and green apron. No spoken words, no coins or modern money. Not three equal rectangles. End with his hand at stomach; no diner or Elna visible yet.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 包丁の音を先に届け、湯気を追って食堂へ着く。

soundEffects.source: cook knife tapping chopping board inside window
soundEffects.placement: small rhythmic dark-brown lettering at the upper chopping hand

scenes.description: ONE long borderless vertical composition, portrait approximately 1:3, a camera journey rather than a page grid. At the top only a partial open diner window and the cream sleeve of the unseen cook's knife hand chopping on a CLEAN kitchen board; warm steam drifts downward through empty ivory space; at the bottom Kou at the lane looks toward the same blue-awning timber diner. Elna's face is not shown yet. Garden remains wilted. No harvest of new crops.

Wide panel: Kou pauses outside diner blue awning, hungry, Elna at serving window to his left. Small inset of his hand on stomach. Lower medium panel of Elna turning toward vegetable plot. Keep paved lane left and beds right of diner.

soundEffects.source: Kou's empty stomach
soundEffects.placement: small beside his stomach in the adopted original

scenes.scrollPurpose: 料理人が、農夫へ畑の相談をする理由を作る。
dialogue: 七年、野菜を作ってました。
scenes.description: TWO unequal conversation panels beside the same blue-awning diner, no location change. Upper medium Elna studies Kou's muddy apron and trowel with cautious interest, lower larger closeup of Kou answering, not smug. Elna on his LEFT, Kou on RIGHT, correct adult faces and clothes. No garden diagnosis or future reply. Ordinary affordable cookware.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 食堂と畑の位置を、歩く視線と水の跡でつなぐ。

soundEffects.source: Kou boot meets small puddle on path
soundEffects.placement: soft small letters at water contact, away from faces

scenes.description: ONE borderless vertical camera journey from the blue diner awning at the upper-left along the narrow stone side path toward wilted garden beds to the right. Elna leads, Kou follows; below, the reader sees wet paving, boots at the edge and sagging leaves. Keep plants rooted, yellow-green and wilted, no healthy regrowth. The paved lane is left and garden right, under tower ceiling, no outdoor sky.

dialogue: 水も肥料も、増やしたのに。
この土、ずっと湿ってる？
scenes.description: Three unequal panels in the same plot: wide Elna left and crouching Kou right beside wilted broad leafy vegetables; closeup her tense hand holding a small fertilizer sack closed; lower closeup Kou pressing moist soil, not pouring water. Water remains pooled, drain is still blocked.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 表面の乾きと根域の湿りを別々に見る。

soundEffects.source: wet soil compressed gently between fingers
soundEffects.placement: small soft mud-colored letters beside fingers

dialogue: 乾いてるのは、表面だけ。
scenes.description: THREE unequal diagnostic closeups in SAME wilted garden: top shallow closeup of dry crumbly top skin; middle larger Kou's fingers press below it and reveal wet dark soil sticking together; bottom Elna's worried face while holding the CLOSED small fertilizer sack. No watering action, root pulling or instant cure. Kou remains crouched beside Elna.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 触る前に一株の確認を求め、根を見る行動へつなぐ。
scenes.description: TWO quiet medium closeups before the root inspection. Kou is crouching with a hand trowel beside one wilted plant still ROOTED, pointing to that single plant; Elna agrees with a hesitant face. No already extracted plant, no removal before permission. Garden architecture and closed fertilizer sack continue.

dialogue: 葉より先に、根を見たい。
悪い場所も、残して比べよう。
scenes.description: Two medium panels with a narrow hand closeup between: Kou gently exposes one small plant's roots with a trowel; dark compact wet root zone and some damaged roots, no instant healthy glow; Elna silently watches and responds to his cautious expression. Exactly one dug plant, nearby plants remain rooted.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 根の傷みを見て、水の出口を調べる判断へ進む。

soundEffects.source: one muddy water droplet falling off exposed soil
soundEffects.placement: small understated letters next to droplet

scenes.description: TWO unequal panels following the existing root inspection: upper large precise closeup of the SAME one small wilted leafy plant held gently, wet compact dark soil on damaged brown roots; lower shoulder-view of Kou explaining briefly while Elna listens. No magical glow, no healthy bright roots or revived leaves. Only this one plant is uprooted, others remain in beds.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 世話をしたのに悪化した気持ちを受け止める。
scenes.description: TWO uneven emotional shots in the same plot: upper large close face of Elna, headscarf and lower ponytail, holding her small CLOSED fertilizer sack against chest, ashamed but capable; lower off-center close face of Kou with patient expression looking toward path drain, no accusation. Wilted plants stay wilted. No new person.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 水の跡を下へたどり、出口の位置を見つける。

soundEffects.source: drop from saturated soil falling into stagnant edge puddle
soundEffects.placement: small thin gray-blue lettering near upper drop

scenes.description: ONE tall borderless approximately 1:3 vertical camera journey, showing wet soil at garden edge near top, a small stagnant trickle reaching downward between stone edging and wet footprints, then a wooden inspection lid partly entering the bottom. No opened lid, no litter yet revealed, no repaired strong flow. People mostly offscreen, only Kou's brown boot and pointed hand guide observation. Plot to right, side path to left.

dialogue: この出口、誰が管理してる？
店の区画は、私が掃除する決まり。
scenes.description: Three unequal conversation panels at removable wooden drain inspection cover near plot edge: Kou asks while pointing at cover; Elna with diner blue awning behind answers; their hands reach for the same cover after permission. Drain not flowing yet, leaves and silt block its opening.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 木蓋の重さと手順を小さい動作で読む。

soundEffects.source: wooden lid lifted
soundEffects.placement: thin creaky brown letters along rising lid

soundEffects.source: wooden lid rests on paving
soundEffects.placement: small low-weight lettering at lower contact

scenes.description: THREE small quick asymmetric action shots after permission. RIGHT upper shot: Kou pulls the iron ring on the wooden inspection lid with his dirty hand. CENTER lower shot: Elna lifts the SAME rectangular wooden lid by the edge with both hands. LEFT lowest shot: she rests the lid upright safely on paving. The open channel is still blocked with packed wet leaves, no flowing water yet. No digging or breaking sandstone.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 何が水を止めるか、詰まりの場所を接写で示す。
scenes.description: THREE unequal observations of the SAME open inspection channel. Upper precise closeup of a compact mat of leaves and mud wedged at accessible mouth of shallow stone outlet; middle Kou crouches and points without removing it; lower small Elna looks at his pointing hand. Stagnant water is upstream of the mat, downstream still only damp. Elna keeps the lid aside upright. No drained bed or lush plants.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 掃除の前に受け入れ先を確かめる。
scenes.description: ONE large wide situation panel within a tall portrait field, with a smaller downward eye-line inset: Kou follows the shallow downstream stone channel toward the OPEN common receiver beside the lane. The downstream path is unobstructed and not overflowing. He checks before clearing the upstream blockage. Elna remains nearby holding/resting the cover aside, not vanished or at another location. No water gush yet, no structural excavations.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 掃除を一動作で済ませず、道具と泥の抵抗を描く。

soundEffects.source: wet leaves land in dirty utility bucket
soundEffects.placement: soft heavy brown lettering by bucket rim

scenes.description: THREE tight quick diagonally bordered action closeups, all upright lettering: top-right Kou's small hand trowel scrapes packed wet leaf litter; middle-left his hand transfers removed litter into an ordinary dirty garden bucket on paving; lower wide hand closeup loosens the remaining small twig at the outlet. Elna helps hold the lid aside. The last obstruction remains, so water is not yet gushing. No clean food bowl, no fertilizer applied.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 小さな予兆の音から、水が動く結果まで待たせる。

soundEffects.source: air and water shifting under the loosened leaf mat
soundEffects.placement: small low dark-blue lettering near upper water bubble, exact ellipsis

scenes.description: One spare macro closeup of a tiny air bubble at the open still-partly-blocked stone outlet near the upper fifth, no people and no lid across the channel. ゴ…… lies beside the bubble. Fade to quiet pale ivory below the upper third; no released stream yet.

One tall flowing composition plus two small unequal hand closeups at the top: Kou removes leaf litter and silt from accessible outlet, Elna holds lifted cover aside; clear visible flow then follows the channel downward and out safely to common drain. No digging through structural wall, no flooding other houses, wilted plants remain wilted. The visible action causes the flow.

soundEffects.source: air and water escape the cleared outlet
soundEffects.placement: drawn beside the outlet in the adopted original

scenes.scrollPurpose: 流れる水を下へ追う長い見せ場。

soundEffects.source: released water through the cleared stone channel
soundEffects.placement: large flowing blue-gray drawn letters parallel to current in upper third, no balloon

scenes.description: One uninterrupted borderless tall water path, with no people or panel frames. Water leaves the cleared stone outlet, curves downward through the shallow stone channel and joins the common drain. Removed leaves are in a dirty utility bucket at top, wooden cover rests upright outside. Wilted yellow-green plants remain wilted. Large ざああっ follows the current in upper third. No magic.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 作業の片付けと手洗いを、食堂へ入る前に描く。

soundEffects.source: wood lid settles onto inspection frame
soundEffects.placement: small subdued brown letters at lid edge

soundEffects.source: clean wash water runs over hands
soundEffects.placement: fine flowing gray-blue letters near lower hands

scenes.description: THREE brisk unequal closeups before entering the kitchen. Top: Kou replaces the SAME wooden inspection cover over the accessible channel while water passes beneath it; the cover is not a plug in the outlet. Middle: dirty trowel and litter bucket are parked OUTSIDE beside the plot. Bottom: Kou rinses his dirty hands using a ladle of clean water over an outdoor utility basin, Elna holds a plain water jug. No brand-new high tank or filter from future episode 4. No food prep in utility basin.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 水が動いた喜びと、作物を待つ時間を分ける。
scenes.description: TWO unequal quiet emotion panels at the same now-flowing drain. Upper larger Elna sees moving water, eyes widen and shoulders ease, but she does not celebrate restored plants. Lower Kou looks to the still-wilted bed with cautious hope, the cleared drain and resting lid still nearby. No supporting heroes, no recovered crop, no harvest.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 火と鍋の音から、温かい一皿の披露へつなぐ。

soundEffects.source: small cooking fire crackles
soundEffects.placement: small warm ochre letters near fire

soundEffects.source: stew pours from ladle into bowl
soundEffects.placement: rounded dark-brown letters next to ladle pour, keep food visible

scenes.description: TWO appetizing unequal closeups inside the original timber diner AFTER garden work and handwash. Upper shallow view of flame and closed/open edge of a cooking pot with steam. Lower large closeup Elna's CLEAN hand and ladle portions a stew of purchased barley, brown meat, orange root vegetable and greens into the SAME mottled brown-gray ceramic bowl of the following first-meal scene. No just-grown vegetables or farm tools on counter. Kou offscreen sitting and waiting.

Three panels with final large warm scene: Elna sets a steaming barley-and-meat bowl on diner counter for Kou; closeup his rough hands near the bowl as he looks worried toward the still wilted garden; final Elna's gentle expression and Kou's relieved face in warm kitchen lamplight. Vegetables and grain are already purchased or existing, not newly grown. No miraculous lush plot.

scenes.scrollPurpose: 食事を受け止め、明日の仕事を約束して閉じる。

soundEffects.source: Kou gently blows steam off spoon
soundEffects.placement: small soft drawn letters beside breath, not in speech balloon

scenes.description: THREE unequal quiet final moments, not equal rectangles. Top small closeup of Kou blowing gently on a spoonful from the SAME mottled ceramic stew bowl, matching barley, brown meat, orange root and greens. Middle LARGE closeup of his softened face after tasting, his rough hands now clean, warmth rather than victory smugness. Bottom wider quiet counter scene, Elna asks from LEFT and Kou answers slightly lower RIGHT; leave airy ivory space between reactions. No crop recovery, new morning or future customer. Garden seen through doorway is still wilted.
